test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 02 May 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Seven boys J, K, L, M, N, P and Q are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). P is second to the right of Q. M is the immediate neighbour of both J and Q. L is not the immediate neighbour of Q. N is second to the right of P. Who is to the immediate left of L?
solution: Given: Seven boys J, K, L, M, N, P and Q. 1) P is second to the right of Q. 2) N is second to the right of P. 3) M is the immediate neighbour of both J and Q.
